verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no itinerary-linked trip report that automatically pulls together bookings, card spend and receipts. The closest items earn no credit. Clara's homepage claims generic "automated expense reporting." Trip-scoped virtual cards with auto-deletion are an adjacent card-provisioning feature. Labels that attach project IDs to transactions through the API are a developer building block for a user to assemble such a report themselves. Nothing mentions booking or itinerary ingestion or receipt capture.
